lines: How Often People in the U.S. Ate Fast Food in 2023
The graph shows how often people in the U.S. ate fast food in 2023.
More than 50 percent of people ate fast food once a week or more.
The most common response was “a few times a week,” chosen by 36 percent of people.
The second most common response was “a few times a month,” given by 18 percent of people.
The percentage of people who ate fast food once every two months was less than that of those who ate it every day.
Less than 10 percent of people said they rarely or never ate fast food.
